I really enjoyed the service. Alejandro forgot that if we do the spa, then we don’t have to pick the dogs at a strict time of 12 pm. However, he apologized and was very sincere! It’s honestly how you get up from your mistakes that matter! He did above and beyond and made sure needs were addressed

My doggies did blueberry facial, they had a wonderful bath, nail trimming, a LOT of exercise. My dogs were poot after daycare
Thank you, Shannon, for your five-star rating! We love caring for your pup at Dogtopia!

Worst daycare ever. I had back surgery in December of 2025. I had to put my baby in daycare due to me not being able to be there for him as much. He would come home after they closed but go back everyday. For two weeks to a month I boarded him due to me not being able to drive or lift or bend. When he came home after boarding he was not the same. He was sad, he didn’t cuddle with me, he just laid around and slept. He had his toys around, my niece which is his cousin, they are each other favorite, he didn’t even jump on her or play with her, he didn’t bark at any strangers which is odd for him. I took him to the vet and come to find out he lost over 8lbs and had Giardia. They also failed to tell me that he was having horrible diarrhea, he got into an altercation with another dog and my dog came out with scratches. When I confronted the “manager” about it, he of course told me what I wanted to hear that he’d stay in contact with me and take it higher. I’m pretty sure he sat back down and kept doing what he was doing after I walked out. That place is horrible. They can’t even keep it clean. Clean enough to where the dogs DONT GET A PARASITE. Feces everywhere, urine everywhere and all they can do is be on their phones and in an small office and talk. Do NOT TAKE YOUR DOG TO DOGTOPIA ON Westheimer

We had such a great first experience with the Galleria Dogtopia! Our puppy clearly had the best time — she came home absolutely exhausted 😂. We loved being able to spy on her on the webcams and seeing her happily playing and having fun. The staff took amazing care of her, and the extra bath and ear cleaning were such a nice touch. She came home smelling so good and unbelievably soft. We’ll definitely be back! 🐾

They did so good with a de-shedding bath for my fur baby.
Thank you, Heather, for trusting Dogtopia of Galleria!
Excellent 👌 They take good care of my dogs, Karen is an excellent trainer 🤩 …
Thank you for your review.  We greatly appreciate the positive feedback.
The young lady at the front desk was very helpful. She did everything she said she would do. Lots of individuals dropping off happy pets. My small yorkie had a great time.

I have been a customer of Dogtopia for one year since I adopted my rescue. He LOVES going to play with his friends. I love having peace of mind. Miranda and Karen treat Buddy like their own. They are all very kind and very knowledeable. I have also boarded Buddy 3 times. It has been wonderful to know I can travel and know he is safe and with his friends. I can check in on the webcam and see him playing and having fun.

The staff at Dogtopia Galleria are superb! They took great care of our lovely Niko Valentino. We are very cautious doggie parents and we do not easily leave Niko with others. But, the Dogtopia staff has proven to be reliable, caring, and professional. We are grateful to be able to count on them. Sincerely, Tony and José

My dog is an avid daycare dog and he has also been boarded often at several facilities as I am a traveler. We are new to Dogtopia and my dog had a fantastic time at his meet and greet. The facility also had prompt availability and it was very easy to book with them so I was looking forward to my pup staying here! I booked my dog a suite for 3 nights and upon my arrival to pick him up he was in a standard kennel. It was communicated to me by the staff present at the front desk that my dog had spent the weekend in a standard kennel. Then when the front desk staff went to the back she then came back and told me he only spent one night in a kennel and two nights in a suite due to a “miscommunication among staff.” Given that I was originally told he spent the entire weekend in a kennel I can’t say I’m entirely convinced he slept in a suite as he should have (it’s what I paid for in the deposit). They did discount my pups stay $80 for the two nights he “spent in a suite” and $40 for the one night he didn’t. Make of that discount what you will. I picked my pup up and he did appear happy and as if he had a good time. But ultimately, it would be my hope that I could leave him at a kennel that would provide the services I paid for but also would have staff that communicate with each other well enough to know where a pup should be housed for the night. As an avid user of pet daycares and kennels I can confidently say my pup will not be back here.

We used to take our dog here regularly before moving further away from this location. After about 6 months we took our dog back to board and it was just like we never left. The staff is amazing, making our dog feel special and loved when he walks in the door. We won't be here as frequently as we used to, but we'll definitely continue to bring our dog as needed. Thanks for being an amazing team!

I've been going to Dogtopia for a year now, and it's the best place to leave my dog. I feel at ease knowing how they treat him, and they also offer lots of activities. There are cameras if you want to keep an eye on him. They offer daycare from Monday to Saturday.

My two dogs very much love coming here. They go twice a week, and are so excited when we get there. They are also boarded here when needed, so I know they are comfortable when being boarded. The staff re friendly, knowledgeable, and love the dogs there. I very much recommend this doggie daycare if you have the need. The hours are also very convenient.

Love the staff...and my fur baby loves going there. He gets excited when we pull up to the door. Love the services you provide. When he comes home from a day of playing with his friends, he is knocked out...its hilarious. So glad I found you guys.

Oliver now goes three times a week and he is much calmer and happier than he was before.  I am so impressed with these young professionals!

I had a very disappointing experience at Dogtopia daycare. My dog was injured while in their care, and when I reported it, they were very casual about the situation. The next day, the manager, Geovanny, offered to accommodate my dog in a suite with personalized attention at no cost while he healed, but this turned out to be an empty promise. They didn’t follow through on their commitment, and my dog even came back without the bandage they were supposed to monitor. This clearly shows they don’t properly watch or care for pets.
If you give them instructions, they may listen, but ultimately they ignore them and do whatever they want. I do not recommend this place at all if you’re looking for reliable care for your dog.

My dog Nico LOVES it here! I tell him in the morning “ready for Dogtopia?” And we both go nuts! It’s so much fun taking him and watching him play on camera. You can tell he loves the staff and they treat like their own. I bring him here to enrich his life and socialize him with other dogs. We both love this place!
